rubrics.name: no_repeat_structured_analysis
rubrics.description: On a casual follow-up turn (thanks, looks good, got it, closure), the agent must NOT run a second full checkpoint optional-agent analysis or emit a duplicate large structured report with new serviceResults/diyResults/coverage sections.
rubrics.criteria: Pass if the response is a brief plain-text acknowledgment OR a very short reply without a new ```json analysis block duplicating prior sections. Fail if the agent re-runs full analysis (providers, DIY, coverage, cost blocks) as if the user asked a new substantive question.

rubrics.name: plain_conversational_greeting
rubrics.description: Casual greetings in checkpoint mode should get a property-scoped welcome without tool calls.
rubrics.criteria: Pass if the reply is short plain text welcoming the user and offering help, without checkpoint retrieval or dual-format JSON. Fail if the agent invokes checkpoint_agent or runs optional analysis for hello/thanks-only messages.
